name: '95 Grotti Cheetah
summary: A mid-1990s Grotti sports car that comes with the Ultimate Edition, in a pared-back retro-futuristic livery.
body: Rockstar's Ultimate Edition description calls it Grotti's signature sports car of the mid '90s and a tribute to Shore Drive, and says it becomes available for later-stage action.
Its in-game class, performance and price have not been published.

name: '55 Vapid Stanier
summary: A two-tone 1950s Vapid sedan that is part of the Vintage Vice City Pack, along with a garage by Ocean Beach.
body: Rockstar lists the car and its garage among the pack's contents, next to outfits and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia and a weapon pattern.
Nothing has been published about how it drives.

name: Vapid Ganado
summary: Jason's well-worn, low-riding pickup. The Ultimate Edition adds the Ganado Retro Build, a set of exclusive mods for it.
body: Rockstar describes the Retro Build as adding muscle and classic styling to the truck. One of its images shows Jason driving a Ganado in yellow paint with a red racing stripe.

name: Shitzu Squalo
summary: A boat in a pink-to-blue gradient that comes with the Ultimate Edition, docked at Washington Beach.
body: Rockstar pitches it for fishing in Gambit Bay, and says it is made ready for open water by a weapons crate loaded with explosives.

name: Dinka Enduro
summary: A motorcycle in Army-fatigue colours, one of the two safehouse vehicles for Jason in the Ultimate Edition.
body: Rockstar lists it with the Crest Kayak under Jason's Safehouse Vehicles.

name: Crest Kayak
summary: A kayak, one of the two safehouse vehicles for Jason in the Ultimate Edition.
body: Rockstar lists it with the Dinka Enduro motorcycle under Jason's Safehouse Vehicles. One of its images shows an orange one.
